changes: Added English translations for catalog descriptions, library notes, genres, consoles and seasonal collections while preserving original library records and saved progress.
Compacted the game diary and aligned play status with the rating source; priority chips now open the matching catalog filter.
Rebuilt seasonal frame rendering with fixed ornaments and identical source-pixel stripes on all four sides. Added a new Halloween frame and a brighter PlayStation scene.

Redrew both decorative achievement frames with restrained plum casing, a counter trophy at the upper right and gold trim on the latest achievement; simplified individual trophy cards and refreshed statistics, Trophy Room, Player Profile and the console timeline.
Aligned Now Playing and Play Next covers, titles, metadata, ratings and footers on the same grid; both footer controls now share identical computed styles.

Corrected the cassette label symmetry, display and Play/Pause artwork; added a cassette icon with blank physical buttons, preserved cream label and no lettering or control symbols; moved the four autumn horror tracks into Halloween.
Added Current year to the calendar, centered close controls and enabled backdrop dismissal for dialogs.
Removed obsolete decorative resources and their page references, and made final styles available before the first paint.

Added irregular flicker bursts and occasional 1–8 second outages with recovery flashes for the complete G and A in GAME, keeping ME steady; made ON AIR depend on a successful current-session RetroAchievements response and replaced recurring flicker with a brief fluorescent-lamp burst only when switching on or off, plus a quiet electrical click after user interaction; expanded the achievement counter to five digits.
Added the supplied Leaves, Slow down and Downpour tracks to the calendar-based Autumn playlist, separate from Halloween.

Redrew the complete cassette in matching Full, Mini and blank-key Icon sizes, with centered solid black pixel-grid symbols matching the user reference, a latched Shuffle state, vertical mode indicators and a turquoise physical side switch; the display shows playlist - track on one line with time below and opens playlist selection and All tracks playback.
Extended the achievement-counter sweep to the frame edges with occasional paired scan bands.
Gave saved Seasonal discoveries a dedicated pixel-art cover; verified that this group restores explicitly adopted seasonal games without adding recommendations automatically.
Prepared 106 original track titles and generation prompts covering 44 seasonal and event collections.
